name: Challenge: Blank frames isolate artwork and frame-duration edits undo independently
description: Exercise the compiled local PixiBun build through user controls. Use a desktop viewport. Compare actual artwork and persistent state, not only element visibility. Missing prerequisites or unobservable cancellation must be reported rather than silently skipped.

planSteps.description: Verify restoration has finished and the main drawing canvas is editable.
Draw a short horizontal stroke in the upper-left quarter of the drawing canvas, away from its borders.
Set Active frame duration in milliseconds to 240 and commit by leaving the field.
Click + Frame to add a blank frame.
Verify two frames exist, frame 2 is active and its drawing canvas is blank rather than a copy of frame 1.
Draw a separate short vertical stroke in the lower-right quarter of the drawing canvas.
Set Active frame duration in milliseconds to 700 and commit by leaving the field.
Verify frame 2 reports 700ms and contains only the vertical stroke.
Verify frame 2 duration returns to its value before 700 was entered while its vertical stroke remains intact.
Verify frame 1 retains its horizontal stroke, has no vertical stroke and still reports 240ms.
Verify only the vertical stroke returns; changing frames has not mixed artwork.
